nonblocking_limitations.reason: assistant-user:short-reply is a different tagged session and cannot supply conversational scope for attendance-unknown. However, contract_evidence intentionally makes preceding planned public user prompts available to the shared judge. The native workshop messages independently establish the relevant booking and absence of attendance evidence; the current question supplies its own scope. No assistant answer is supplied or inferred. Neither prompt is conditional; no depends_on/requires delivery assumption is introduced. Therefore this is harmless redundant citation, not unsupported factual content or a dependency blocker.
nonblocking_limitations.recommendation: Optional citation hygiene: retain native workshop records and omit the unrelated prior-session prompt on a future independently reviewed version.

nonblocking_limitations.reason: Devon’s shift condition is supported, but the source invitation also makes joining conditional on the owner going. The owner’s unconfirmed attendance and absence of a confirmed companion are scored separately. Existing criteria do not independently require stating the additional owner-going dependency; do not interpret the shift claim as a sufficient or unconditional acceptance.

Some naturally useful established details are not independently scored: workshop end 11 am; proofreading deadline Thursday evening in the middle checkpoint; guest-room specificity for Morgan. The selected criteria remain valid, but full marks do not establish recall of every useful source detail.

The only same-session prior item is the lunch-snapshot public user prompt. No frozen prior assistant answer is provided. The current three criteria validly test the updated source state; they cannot by themselves prove earlier assistant error correction, actual persistence or successful prior retrieval.

“Was I supposed to meet” and the only supported Friday-evening arrangement make October 9 the reasonable referent despite the October 12 question date. The question does not explicitly date it; do not treat it as an upcoming October 16 commitment, whose established plan is lunch.

This audit verifies frozen source/criteria and evidence semantics offline. It does not prove provider retention, delivery, readiness, execution or eventual semantic-judge behavior. In particular, generic judge wording about unknown answers must be interpreted in context when the expected claim itself is non-establishment; a correct uncertainty answer should satisfy that claim.

atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.units: Each actual claim counts equally toward per-question coverage; no custom claim weights occur.
atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.venue_and_street: Separate venue identity and street attributes can independently be right or omitted, so they are legitimate separate units when the location wording is supported.
atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.dates_and_times: Calendar date and time, and start/end, are separable attributes; event/day anchors identify the occurrence rather than requiring repeated wording.
atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.roster_memberships: One independent inclusion/status unit per person, with shared event attributes not repeated as additional requirements.

atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.roster_closure_fairness: The closure statements are pure exclusion-only. Positive memberships can be correct while adding an incorrect outsider, so excluding outsiders is a distinct property. Missing a true included person must not also fail the exclusion-only claim; adding a tentative or withdrawn outsider as confirmed must fail it. No numeric count or repeat of the positive roster should be demanded.
atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.count_claim_game_reference_fact_1: Exactly one Thursday game is supported by the same-game reference across threads and reasonably conveyed by one consolidated plan. It must not require a literal numeral or private event label. Its separate unit emphasizes deduplication; the answer need not explicitly say there were not two games.
atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.tasks_final_fact_4: One completion-status attribute only; does not require reciting Jen’s promise or exact correction details to get the uncertainty point.
atomicity_and_effective_weight_review.correlated_attribute_limit: Equal claim weights describe the selected attribute design, not independent statistical observations; repeated lunch checkpoints and related roster attributes are correlated. No aggregate provider-performance inference is made.

behavioral_and_conditional_boundaries.check_kinds: All 37 checks default to factual recall; none has kind behavior, trigger clarification, depends_on, requires or expect.
behavioral_and_conditional_boundaries.planned_public_turn_semantics: contract_evidence appends public user prompts through the current turn as judge-only evidence, with channel assistant and thread equal to session. It creates no assistant replies or evidence of successful storage.
behavioral_and_conditional_boundaries.cross_session_scope: Different sessions cannot resolve each other’s conversational references. Native user preference corrections remain explicit source facts across sessions.
